title: Stranger in Warm Light
description: A beatless glassy pad drifts in alone, then a bright bitcrushed arpeggio glimmers on top before a soft Casio kit shuffles delicately underneath. The groove stays intimate and warm, opening up gently before stripping back to just the pad and a fading bell.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(380,720)).room(0.6).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(420,820)).room(0.55).gain(0.5),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("<C3:minor C3:dorian>").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).crush(7).delay(0.4).room(0.5).gain(0.46)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.32))
  )],
  [28, stack(
    note("<[c2,g2] [ab1,eb2] [f1,c2] [g1,d2]>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(520,1000)).room(0.5).gain(0.5),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2").scale("<C3:minor C3:dorian>").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).crush(7).delay(0.4).room(0.45).gain(0.46)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.34)),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.4).pan(perlin.range(0.35,0.65)).room(0.3),
    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.08, 4),
    s("~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.42).room(0.4)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>/2").s("triangle").decay(0.4).sustain(0.2).room(0.7).delay(0.5).gain(0.5),
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(440,880)).room(0.6).gain(0.48)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<[c2,g2] [ab1,eb2] [f1,c2] [g1,d2]>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(600,1200)).room(0.45).gain(0.5),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2").scale("<C3:dorian C3:minor>").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).crush(8).delay(0.45).room(0.45).gain(0.46)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.34)).every(4, x => x.rev()),
    s("hh(7,8,1)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.4).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7)).room(0.3).cut(1),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.08, 4),
    s("~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.44).room(0.4).vowel("<a o>"),
    s("rim(3,8)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.34).room(0.35)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(360,640)).room(0.65).gain(0.48),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C3:minor").s("triangle").decay(0.5).sustain(0).room(0.7).delay(0.5).gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.3)
  )]
)
